explain.title: How we work out your estimate
paragraphs: The price depends on how much talk time the AI uses for you. The phone and the website widget are counted separately because they're used differently: a phone call usually lasts two to three minutes, while a widget conversation is often shorter.

You choose the phone talk time yourself. We estimate the widget from your calls: some of the people who ring you today will ask on your website instead. If the AI should also handle your online shop or food delivery, we add extra conversations, because customers ask about products, stock, orders and delivery. If you know your own figure, just change it.

From the talk time we find the smallest plan that covers your needs. Setup and onboarding are available as an optional one-off payment, and if you choose the 7-day free trial, we can help you set up for free during the trial.
The estimate is a starting point. Your dashboard always shows your actual usage on each channel, and you can change plan if you use more or less than expected.
